14
  Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters
(Amendment)

12.
Section  12  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended in subsection (2) thereof, by the substitution for the
words “shall be deemed to authorize-”, of the words “shall
be sufficient authorization for-”.

13.
Section  13  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended in subsection (2) thereof, by the substitution for the
words “shall be deemed to authorize the”, of the words “shall
be sufficient authorization for”.

14.
The  following  new  sections  are  hereby  inserted
immediately after section 13 of the principal enactment and
shall have effect as sections 13A and 13B of that enactment:-

“Facilitation
13A. Where a court or competent authority
of video

such  manner  as  may  be  prescribed,  from  a
witness who is physically present in a foreign
State and unable to attend court in Sri Lanka.
The  hearing  shall  be  conducted  directly  by  a
judicial officer or law enforcement officer.

Joint
13B.  When  a  request  is  made  where  an
investigations.
offence  is  committed  involving  persons  or
property  in  multiple  countries,  the  Central
Authority shall facilitate provisions to establish
a joint investigation, comprising of investigators
from Sri Lanka and any specified countries or
specified organizations.”.
